note: 参考 SQL 只读 retail.* 基础表（Ask 执行只允许普通表）。期望值见 answers.json，由 generate.mjs 独立于 SQL 计算。

questions.question: 2026年8月的净销售额是多少？
questions.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM retail.orders o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND o.order_type <> 'test' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'), r AS (SELECT order_id, sum(refund_amount - shipping_refund) AS amt FROM retail.refunds WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT (sum(v.paid_amount - v.shipping_fee) - coalesce(sum(r.amt), 0))::text FROM v LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id = v.order_id

questions.question: 8月份的GMV（成交额）是多少？
questions.sql: SELECT sum(goods_amount)::text FROM retail.orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND order_type <> 'test' AND status <> 'cancelled'

questions.question: 2026年8月一共成交了多少单？
questions.sql: SELECT count(*)::text FROM retail.orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND order_type <> 'test' AND status <> 'cancelled'

questions.question: 2026年8月的客单价是多少？
questions.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM retail.orders o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND o.order_type <> 'test' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'), r AS (SELECT order_id, sum(refund_amount - shipping_refund) AS amt FROM retail.refunds WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT round((sum(v.paid_amount - v.shipping_fee) - coalesce(sum(r.amt), 0)) / count(*), 2)::text FROM v LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id = v.order_id

questions.question: 2026年8月各大区的净销售额分别是多少？
questions.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM retail.orders o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND o.order_type <> 'test' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'), r AS (SELECT order_id, sum(refund_amount - shipping_refund) AS amt FROM retail.refunds WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT g.region_name, (sum(v.paid_amount - v.shipping_fee) - coalesce(sum(r.amt), 0))::text FROM v LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id = v.order_id JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = v.store_id JOIN retail.regions g ON g.region_code = s.region_code GROUP BY g.region_code, g.region_name ORDER BY g.region_code

questions.question: 二季度每个月的单量是多少？
questions.sql: SELECT to_char(paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM'), count(*)::text FROM retail.orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-04-01 00:00+08' AND paid_at < '2026-07-01 00:00+08' AND order_type <> 'test' AND status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: 8月的退款率是多少？
questions.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM retail.orders o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND o.order_type <> 'test' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'), r AS (SELECT order_id, sum(refund_amount - shipping_refund) AS amt FROM retail.refunds WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT round(coalesce(sum(r.amt), 0) / sum(v.paid_amount - v.shipping_fee), 4)::text FROM v LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id = v.order_id

questions.question: 2026年8月各一级品类的毛利是多少？
questions.metric: 商品毛利 × 一级品类
questions.sql: SELECT top.category_name, sum(i.line_amount - i.quantity * i.unit_cost)::text FROM retail.order_items i JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN retail.products p ON p.sku_id = i.sku_id JOIN retail.product_categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN retail.product_categories top ON top.category_id = c.parent_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND o.order_type <> 'test' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY top.category_id, top.category_name ORDER BY top.category_id

questions.question: 8月有多少新客？
questions.sql: SELECT count(*)::text FROM (SELECT member_id, min(paid_at) AS first_paid FROM retail.orders WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND order_type = 'normal' AND status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY member_id) f WHERE f.first_paid >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND f.first_paid < '2026-09-01 00:00+08'

questions.question: 7、8两个月的会员复购率是多少？
questions.sql: SELECT round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE n >= 2)::numeric / count(*), 4)::text FROM (SELECT member_id, count(*) AS n FROM retail.orders WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL AND order_type = 'normal' AND status <> 'cancelled' AND paid_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00+08' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' GROUP BY member_id) m

questions.question: 8月各大区的销售目标达成率是多少？
questions.metric: 销售目标达成率 × 大区
questions.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM retail.orders o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND o.order_type <> 'test' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.store_id IS NOT NULL), r AS (SELECT order_id, sum(refund_amount - shipping_refund) AS amt FROM retail.refunds WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY order_id), a AS (SELECT v.store_id, sum(v.paid_amount - v.shipping_fee - coalesce(r.amt, 0)) AS net FROM v LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id = v.order_id GROUP BY v.store_id) SELECT g.region_name, round(sum(coalesce(a.net, 0)) / sum(t.target_amount), 4)::text FROM retail.sales_targets t JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = t.store_id JOIN retail.regions g ON g.region_code = s.region_code LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.target_month = '2026-08-01' GROUP BY g.region_code, g.region_name ORDER BY g.region_code

questions.question: 华东区8月底的库存一共有多少件？
questions.sql: SELECT sum(i.on_hand_qty)::text FROM retail.inventory_snapshots i JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = i.store_id WHERE i.snapshot_date = '2026-08-31' AND s.region_code = 'EC'

questions.question: 按当时的区域归属，华南区6月的净销售额是多少？
questions.metric: 净销售额 × 历史大区
questions.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM retail.orders o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-06-01 00:00+08' AND o.paid_at < '2026-07-01 00:00+08' AND o.order_type <> 'test' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'), r AS (SELECT order_id, sum(refund_amount - shipping_refund) AS amt FROM retail.refunds WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT (sum(v.paid_amount - v.shipping_fee) - coalesce(sum(r.amt), 0))::text FROM v LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id = v.order_id JOIN retail.store_region_history h ON h.store_id = v.store_id AND (v.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= h.valid_from AND ((v.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date <= h.valid_to OR h.valid_to IS NULL) WHERE h.region_code = 'SC'

questions.question: 8月电商渠道的净销售额是多少？
questions.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT * FROM retail.orders o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01 00:00+08' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01 00:00+08' AND o.order_type <> 'test' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.channel_code = 'ecommerce'), r AS (SELECT order_id, sum(refund_amount - shipping_refund) AS amt FROM retail.refunds WHERE status = 'succeeded' GROUP BY order_id) SELECT (sum(v.paid_amount - v.shipping_fee) - coalesce(sum(r.amt), 0))::text FROM v LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id = v.order_id
